WITH product_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    pc.product_type_description,
    AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_quantity,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS order_item_count
  FROM Products p
  JOIN Product_Categories pc
    ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
  LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    product_type_description,
    avg_quantity,
    order_item_count,
    CAST(order_item_count AS DECIMAL(19,10)) /
      NULLIF(SUM(order_item_count) OVER (), 0) AS order_item_share
  FROM product_stats
),
type_averages AS (
  SELECT
    product_type_description,
    AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
    AVG(order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count,
    AVG(order_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share
  FROM product_shares
  GROUP BY product_type_description
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_quantity) AS average_quantity,
  AVG(avg_order_item_count) AS average_order_item_count,
  AVG(avg_order_item_share) AS average_share
FROM type_averages

assumptions.assumption: `product_quantity` is stored as text, so the query converts values that can be interpreted as DECIMAL; nonnumeric values are treated according to the database's cast behavior. Products are associated with their category description through the required category foreign key.
